summary: Production frameworks now support threshold-based summarization, selective removal, and retrieval after compaction. The strongest implementations retain authoritative source pointers and recent raw evidence rather than trusting a free-form summary as memory.

items.text: Claude's context management can clear old tool results selectively and compact a long conversation into a structured summary when a token threshold is reached; the client can retain the full history outside the model's active context.

LangChain SummarizationMiddleware automatically summarizes earlier messages near a token limit while preserving a configurable number of recent messages; ContextEditingMiddleware can instead remove stale tool outputs.

Microsoft Semantic Kernel chat-history reducers offer count-, token-, and summary-based reduction while preserving the system message and valid tool-call pairs, preventing malformed compacted histories.

VS Code Copilot automatically compacts long chat history and supplements it with explicit files, symbols, selections, and tool-derived workspace context, combining a small active frame with on-demand retrieval.

Microsoft LLMLingua provides prompt-compression implementations, including LongLLMLingua's question-aware reordering and token reduction, for empirically testing compressed contexts rather than relying on prose summaries alone.
